title: Moving states while receiving benefits
facts: State-administered benefits such as Medicaid, SNAP and unemployment insurance generally cannot be assumed to transfer automatically when a person establishes residence in another state.
Federal programs such as Social Security follow federal eligibility rules, but the beneficiary still needs to keep relevant contact and payment information current.
Medicare is federal, but Medicare Advantage and Part D plan service areas can make a move relevant to plan enrollment rights.
A move involving benefits should be handled program by program rather than through one universal transfer request.
